title: Chapter 240
text:
The central control room was located in the core area of the headquarters and stored a lot of secrets. Cyberlos had the authority, so he turned off the security measures and brought Han Xiao into the central control room.

Rows of large hard disks were neatly arranged like a bookcase, and all kinds of indicator lights kept flashing. At the end of the central control room was a monitor and control panel. The style of the central control room here was simpler than the underground control room of Stardragon Division 13.

Cyberlos turned on the central control room and obediently entered the ten-digit password to authenticate his fingerprint and iris. In fact, there was a secret alarm system here. Entering a fixed password was a secret alarm command to prevent the higher-ups from being threatened. However, for his own safety, Cyberlos did not want to do anything.

He believed that Han Xiao could easily kill him before he was caught, so he did not want to take the risk.

Therefore, the alarm system became a decoration.

One had to admit that Cyberlos was extremely bold and lawless when he was doing experiments, but when it came to his own life, he immediately became as timid as a mouse.

"What do you want to see?"

"A comprehensive map of the headquarters," Han Xiao said.

Cyberlos operated, and a blueprint of the headquarters appeared on the screen.

Han Xiao took out the modified helmet of Viper from his equipment bag, took a picture of the map, and entered it into the chip's database, automatically building a 3D map model. During this time, he was also quickly memorizing the map, and soon, he found the place where Aurora was locked up.

Thinking of the Destiny's Child that was mentioned earlier, Han Xiao wanted to go and see what was going on. However, Cyberlos said that only the leader had the authority to open the door to the Destiny's Child, so Han Xiao could only give up on the idea.

"Open your confidential information vault."

Cyberlos did as he was told, and all the secrets were displayed in front of Han Xiao without reservation. The trump cards of the Germinal Organization were all revealed.

Another reason he came to the Germinal Organization headquarters was for this information. He had changed the storyline, so the Germinal Organization naturally had some new secrets that he did not know. Furthermore, he was only a player in his previous life, so it was impossible for him to have all the information, such as the parameters of various experiments, the actual deployment of various plans, and so on.

Han Xiao looked at the Super Soldier's exoskeleton. It was indeed a technology developed from the Lightweight Mechanical Arm that he had once left behind. It treated his leftovers as a treasure.

Han Xiao recorded all the information, especially the detailed information of the Hand of Death system. Giving it to the Six Nations could create an unparalleled advantage and cut off the Germinal Organization's last resort. The more useful the information he gave, the faster his mission progress would be.

And that was not all.

Both the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization had a portion of advanced knowledge, so it was rare for them to take advantage of the situation.

His goal was to obtain advanced knowledge!

…

Han Xiao had always liked to maximize his benefits. He was not only doing this for the sake of saving people, but also for the sake of information and advanced knowledge.

"Open the knowledge base."

On the screen, the advanced knowledge for the Martial Path, Esper Ability, and Mechanic Path appeared. Looking at the densely packed specialized knowledge, Han Xiao let out a long sigh of relief. He was secretly excited. After a few months, he could finally obtain new advanced knowledge.

The Germinal Organization's Mechanic class advanced knowledge was [Nerve Connection].

"Confirm."

Learning in progress. Please do not stop … 5% … 43% … 78% …

Successfully learned! You have learned [Nerve Connection]!

The new knowledge appeared in his mind. Han Xiao closed his eyes and felt it for a while. He was secretly overjoyed.

As the name suggested, [Nerve Connection] was an important technology in biomechanics. It could read the nerve signals of living beings and remotely control machines with one's thoughts. This was an upgrade of the control technology, and the reaction speed had increased by a few magnitudes. A new advanced knowledge meant that the number of combinations would increase. Mastering a new technology would allow him to fuse more blueprints, so there was no doubt that it would increase his strength.

It was not easy. I finally got a second advanced knowledge. The previous one was the advanced material science from the Stardragon pit almost a year ago.

Han Xiao did not stay idle. He also recorded the other advanced knowledge for the Martial Path and Esper classes. Even if he did not need them, he could sell them to the players in the future. The benefits were self-evident.

Mastering the source of the technology would allow him to monopolize it and attract the players. This was a core ability, so there was a huge market for it.

When the players reached a high level and started to need advanced knowledge, they would realize that Han Xiao could sell it in bulk. That scene … Han Xiao could not help but worry if his interface could handle it.

Intelligence and knowledge, this was a huge harvest.

Cyberlos watched the entire process. Suddenly, he felt a chill in his heart. He asked in a trembling voice, "You … are an Inhuman?"

After this period of research, the various organizations realized that Inhumans had the ability to learn quickly. Han Xiao's behavior just now was a little suspicious. Cyberlos suddenly thought of this possibility.

Han Xiao suddenly had a bad idea. He chuckled and deliberately misled him. "What do you think?"

Cyberlos' hands and feet instantly turned cold.

The archenemy of the organization was actually an unkillable Inhuman. What was the point of fighting him?

Sh * t!

What's the point of fighting!

It's f * cking over!

"But … you appeared much earlier than the Inhumans." Cyberlos was shocked halfway through his sentence. He looked at Han Xiao as if he had seen a ghost.

Could it be that Zero was the first Inhuman? The Inhuman phenomenon was actually spread by Zero, and it was actually his Esper Ability?

Ignoring Cyberlos, who was getting further and further away from the truth, Han Xiao checked the information. After confirming that there was no mistake, he asked, "Do you have something like a self-destruct program in your mainframe?"

"Who would be stupid enough to set up a self-destruct program in the headquarters? That would be crazy …" Cyberlos wiped his sweat.

At this time, Viper completed the 3D map and was ready. Han Xiao pulled Cyberlos up and yelled, "Turn off the defense measures in Area A-4 and freeze all the surveillance cameras."

Cyberlos hurriedly did as he was told. Area A-4 was where the little girl with the vitality Esper Ability was locked up, right?

"What do you want to do?"

"I want that little girl. Let's go." Han Xiao pushed Cyberlos out of the mainframe room.

Cyberlos was stunned. He could understand why Han Xiao snatched the information, but Aurora was the organization's secret. Han Xiao did not look at the information in detail earlier, but he seemed to know it like the back of his hand.

Then, did he choose him as the hostage because he knew that he would cooperate?

Cyberlos felt a chill down his spine.

This feeling of being completely seen through was like a fear that went deep into his bones, gnawing at his soul.

…

Cyberlos was a very useful amulet. The two of them successfully arrived at Area A-4. After passing through the winding corridors, they finally arrived at the passage leading to Aurora's prison. The defense measures had been turned off backstage.

The two of them came to the door, and the guard stopped them.

"Open the door." Cyberlos tried to appear calm.

The guard was confused. "Mr. Cyberlos, I did not receive any authorization."

"It's just a routine blood draw."

"But, someone is already drawing blood …" The guard hesitated. Seeing Cyberlos's impatient expression, he still opened the door.

Walking into the room, Han Xiao finally saw Aurora. She was thin and small, and her skin was pale from not being exposed to the sun all year round. Locked in the glass wall room, she looked like a beast on display in a zoo.

The little girl was hugging her knees and curling up in the corner, looking at the few people in white coats outside the wall timidly. These people were pushing a small cart full of tools and preparing for the blood draw.

Today, she had to draw her blood again. The pain was still fresh in her memory. Biting her lips, she hoped that this wait could be extended to eternity. However, she knew that this group of people in white coats would come in sooner or later and insert the needle into her blood vessels and bones. She could only watch as her life turned into a bright red torrent and left her body through the needle.

Aurora had fantasized that her sister could save her and leave this place, but she knew that it was just wishful thinking. She did not want her sister to be in danger just to save her. The only thing she could do was to appear optimistic and cheerful in front of Hella so that her sister would not feel worse and reduce her pressure.

At this time, she saw the door open again, and the two of them walked in. She only saw a few flashes of cold light, and then the people in white coats and the guard fell down with blood spurting out.

Aurora blinked her eyes, filled with confusion. She stared blankly at the glass wall that blocked her freedom being opened so easily.

A ferocious-looking strange uncle walked in and extended his hand.

"I'm here to save you. Come with me."
